user.title: Solar & Battery Financials
user.description: Select the sensors of your system. Power sensors must report W or kW.

data_description.grid_sensor: Positive while importing from the grid, negative while exporting.
data_description.price_sensor: What you pay per kWh right now (e.g. a Nordpool or Tibber price sensor).
data_description.export_price_sensor: What you receive per kWh exported. Leave empty to use the import price.

system.name: Solar, battery & inverter
system.description: Leave out what you don't have.

data_description.solar_sensor: DC power from the panels on your main inverter; positive while producing. Don't include AC-coupled panels here.
data_description.ac_solar_sensor: Panels with their own micro-inverter on a separate house circuit (e.g. on a shed), which the main inverter doesn't see. Counted as AC, so they don't affect the inverter efficiency.
data_description.battery_sensor: Positive while discharging into the house, negative while charging.
data_description.inverter_ac_sensor: AC power at the inverter output. Enables measured efficiency and exact loss tracking; without it 96 % efficiency is assumed.
data_description.invert_inverter_ac: Enable if the inverter sensor is negative while supplying the house (e.g. Deye).

export.name: Export price adjustments
export.description: Effective export price = export price × (1 − percentage / 100) − fixed amount. Negative values act as a bonus.

data_description.feed_in_penalty: Amount per kWh deducted from the export price.
data_description.feed_in_penalty_percent: Percentage deducted from the export price, e.g. 20 if you are paid 80 %.

data_description.tracked_devices: Power sensors of appliances or circuits (smart plugs, sub-meters). Optional.

data_description.prefix: Put in front of every entity ID this integration creates. Can't be changed later.

device_names.title: Name your devices
device_names.description: Names used for sensors and on the dashboard. Renaming later keeps entity IDs and history.

device_parents.title: Device hierarchy
device_parents.description: Is a device measured by another device, like a dishwasher plug behind a kitchen circuit meter? Then it's a sub-device: it gets its own costs, but isn't counted twice in the untracked total.

error.unsupported_unit: {sensor} reports power in {unit}. Use a sensor that reports W or kW.
error.inverter_sign: The inverter AC sensor has the wrong sign for this setting while the panels are producing. Toggle 'Invert inverter AC sensor'.
error.parent_not_independent: A device that other devices are part of must itself be independent.
